name: kodak-2383-film-look
title_zh: 把照片锁进柯达2383胶片放映板的固定画框
tagline_zh: 同一系列每张图的裁切坐标、板面纹理、溢色位置都严格对齐，像从同一卷胶片里逐帧截出来的。自带低对比刷痕与红青套准偏移。
tagline_en: Lock every shot into the same 1086×1449 film-board template—identical crops, brushed pigment, and red/cyan.
desc_en: Turn a user-supplied photograph into a vertical film-board artwork using a strict 1086×1449 locked template: an ungraded upper crop at 810×624 px and a smaller 2383-inspired lower crop at 628×456 px, with identical coordinates across a series. Use an adaptive source-derived board with visible low-contrast brushed/rolled pigment texture, plus irregular emulsion overflow, short red/cyan registration
why_zh: 不是滤镜，是模板级约束：上下双裁切区坐标写死，纹理与溢色从源图自适应生成，系列作品能保持肉眼可见的机械。
why_en: Not a filter—a locked template. Fixed dual-crop coordinates plus source-derived pigment and overflow give series a machine-like.
limit_zh: 只接受用户提供的单张照片，输出是1086×1449竖版成品图；不处理批量文件夹、不生成视频帧、不负责调色分级——原图曝。
limit_en: Single photo in, one 1086×1449 board out. No batch, no video frames, no color grading—if the source exposure or WB is off, it won't save you.
